newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Muslim Insurance up 1.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Muslim Insurance up 1.05 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Muslim Insurance Co rose 0.25 rupee, or 1.05 percent, to 24 at the Karachi Stock Exchange on Wednesday after it announced a 17.5 percent cash dividend and 15 percent bonus stocks for the year ended December 31, dealers said.
Some 1,500 shares changed hands in the morning session, which one dealer said was a good turnover given that the scrip was not readily available after the results announcement.
The company paid a 10 percent cash dividend and 10 percent bonus stocks for calendar 1995.
